en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a newly built residential district with several four‑storey apartment blocks, balconies, fenced green areas and paths in the foreground, and a prominent streetlamp on the left. The reverse side contains printed multilingual text identifying the view as a new district of Pécs, along with a Hungarian postage stamp and handwritten Hungarian message and address.
